title: 第18章 十颗第19章 龙虎血脉
lines: 寂静，死一般的寂静！所有的人愣愣的望着那台上破碎的水晶球，只觉得一阵恍惚。
“家主，这灵脉水晶球该不会偷工减料的吧！”
一名长者也是愣了好半晌，最后嘴唇有些干涩的道。
江天也是咽了一口唾沫，旋即白了他一眼。
“你说呢？”
不过这话不管怎么听都像是没什么底气。
一名须发皆白的老者也是被气得吹胡子瞪眼，他看向那名长者，愤愤的道：“莫非，你是在怀疑老夫的实力！”
这名老者正是那灵脉水晶球的铸造者，也是江家唯一一名炼器大师。
不过话虽这般说着，但那老者自己都有些狐疑，莫非是自己老了，要不然的话自己铸造的水晶球什么时候变得那么脆弱了？
“这家伙简直就是怪胎！”
云曦此时就坐在高台上，看着那碎落一地的水晶球，也感到一阵无语。
“作弊！一定是他那颗水晶球被掉包的缘故！”
见到那颗水晶球破裂，江天逸面色青白交替，他疯狂的咆哮着，仿佛在做着最后的挣扎。
不过下一刻，他就察觉到一道道像看白痴一般的目光看着他，这里是演武场，江玄怎么可能在大庭广众之下调包。
一时间，场上竟再次陷入了一片寂静之中。
江玄则是苦笑着摇了摇头，若是依照他原本的实力，的确无法令得灵脉水晶球破碎，但他释放的九星神龙诀力量何等霸道，那种力量已经远远超越了普通真元境强者能够释放的威压。
“咳咳！家主，我看不如两人再比试一番，我们府内似乎还有一颗灵脉水晶球！”
看到场上气氛的尴尬，大长老江霖开口说道。
然而，江天却是摇了摇头，嘴巴有些干涩的道。
“不用了，大长老！这灵脉水晶球何等的坚硬，你我都应该知晓。
江玄既然能够一拳打爆这颗灵脉水晶球，换上另外一颗，结果想来也是一样！”
大长老也是犹豫一下，随即苦笑了起来。
的确，这灵脉水晶球何等的珍贵，若是再一次被江玄击碎了怎么办？
“家主，依我看江玄既然能够击碎水晶球，想来这小子天赋定然不错！我看这第二场的第一名大家也都心知肚明了吧！”
大长老笑了笑说道。
江天犹豫了一下，也是点了点头，他站上高台说道。
“既然灵脉水晶球已经破碎，那么我宣布这一场比试获胜者是”“慢着！”
不过就在这时，一身青衣的一名中年站了起来，他是江家的三长老江穹！同时也是江天逸的父亲。
“家主！这小子虽然击碎了灵脉水晶球，不过我们却并不知晓他是否动用了灵力！”
“没错，我不服！我们根本不知道江玄灵脉究竟有多强，若是让他这样就获胜了，我不服！”
江天逸原面色狰狞的道。
“说的有道理啊！”
“而且，若是江玄刚刚是使用了灵诀才使得灵脉水晶球破碎的话，这样的结果的确是对江天逸太不公平了！”
“的确！这灵脉水晶球可是我们江家第一炼器大师所铸，要是江玄不曾使用灵诀的话，打死我也不相信江玄又能力将其击碎！”
“”听到众人的议论，江天逸脸露得意之色，看向江玄的眼中也是充满一丝挑衅。
“十颗！”
content_en:
Silence, deathly silence! Everyone stared blankly at the broken crystal ball on the stage, feeling in a daze.
"Master, this spiritual crystal ball shouldn't be cutting corners, right?"
An elder was also stunned for a long time, and finally said with dry lips.
Jiang Tian also swallowed his saliva and immediately rolled his eyes at him.
"What do you think?"
However, no matter how you listen to this, it sounds like you have no confidence.
An old man with white beard and hair was also so angry that he blew his beard and glared. He looked at the elder and said angrily: "Could it be that you are doubting my strength!"
This old man was the caster of the spiritual crystal ball and the only master of the Jiang family.
But even though he said this, the old man himself was a little suspicious. Could it be that he was old? Otherwise, when did the crystal ball he cast become so fragile?
"This guy is a freak!"
Yun Xi was sitting on the high platform at this time, looking at the broken crystal ball on the ground, and felt speechless for a while.
"Cheating! It must be because his crystal ball was dropped!"
Seeing the crystal ball break, Jiang Tianyi's face turned green and white, and he roared crazily, as if he was making a final struggle.
But the next moment, he noticed people looking at him like they were looking at idiots. This was a martial arts arena. How could Jiang Xuan change his contract in public?
For a moment, the field fell into silence again.
Jiang Xuan smiled bitterly and shook his head. According to his original strength, it was indeed impossible to break the spiritual crystal ball, but the power of the Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art he released was so overbearing. That kind of power has far exceeded the pressure that ordinary True Yuan realm experts can release.
"Ahem! Master, I don't think it's better for the two of us to compete again. There seems to be a spiritual crystal ball in our house!"
Seeing the awkward atmosphere on the court, the Great Elder Jiang Lin spoke up.
However, Jiang Tian shook his head and said with a dry mouth.
"No need, Great Elder! You and I should know how hard this spiritual crystal ball is.
Since Jiang Xuan was able to blow up this spiritual crystal ball with one punch and replace it with another one, the result would be the same! "
The great elder also hesitated for a moment, and then smiled bitterly.
Indeed, this spiritual crystal ball is so precious. What if it is shattered by Jiang Xuan again?
"Master, in my opinion, since Jiang Xuan can break the crystal ball, he must be very talented! I think everyone knows the first place in the second game!"
The great elder smiled and said.
Jiang Tian hesitated for a moment, then nodded. He stood on the high platform and said.
"Since the spiritual crystal ball has been shattered, I declare the winner of this competition to be" "Wait!"
But at this moment, a middle-aged man in green clothes stood up. He was Jiang Qiong, the third elder of the Jiang family! He is also the father of Jiang Tianyi.
"Master! Although this kid shattered the spiritual crystal ball, we don't know whether he used his spiritual power!"
"That's right, I don't accept it! We don't know how strong Jiang Xuan's spiritual veins are. If he wins like this, I don't accept it!"
Jiang Tianyi said with a ferocious expression.
"That makes sense!"
"Moreover, if Jiang Xuan had just used the spirit technique to break the spirit crystal ball, such a result would indeed be too unfair to Jiang Tianyi!"
"Indeed! This spiritual vein crystal ball was made by our Jiang family's number one weapon refiner. If Jiang Xuan had not used the spiritual art, I would not believe that Jiang Xuan would be able to break it to pieces!"
"" Hearing everyone's discussion, Jiang Tianyi's face showed a proud look, and his eyes when looking at Jiang Xuan were full of provocation.
"Ten!"
